rule: A region-rolled weather. A timer (fallback interval in game hours) expires; every region forgets its weather; the current region rolls 1 to 100 over its cumulative chance table. Changes are real-time crossfades: the factor falls by elapsed real seconds times the incoming weather's speed. A change requested mid-crossfade is queued, and overflow time is carried into the queued crossfade. Colours have four time-of-day keys with pre and post bands and linear blends. Sun orbit is linear within day and within night. Thunder: strike chance per frame is frequency times 10 per minute, scaled by how far the transition is past threshold; flash is additive across strikes, decays per second, and has four distance bins. Rain emission is max drops over entrance speed times 20 per second. Clouds scroll at speed over 400 per second.

look_test: Publish a style flag on the existing arena scene via the look-test flag (/preview/, no release rows). Three presets: clear noon; overcast dusk with a slow crossfade; storm with flashes about every 10 seconds. On a 375-wide phone check that hero and three-attacker ring stay readable through a flash, that a crossfade does not pop, and that rain count is comfortable. Compare four-key dusk against a single key.
